name: How long does a garage conversion project usually take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a garage conversion project usually take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a garage conversion project can vary, but generally takes between 3 to 6 months from initial design to final inspection. This includes time for architectural plans, city permits, construction, and final finishing touches. Permitting in Los Angeles can sometimes extend the overall duration, so choosing a contractor familiar with local regulations can help streamline the process. Unexpected structural issues or design changes can also affect the project timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: A garage conversion usually takes 3 to 6 months, including design, permitting, and construction, though permitting times can vary.
